claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Azaperone is a butyrophenone antipsychotic with no cytotoxic pharmacophore; at 2.5 uM for 5 days it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak, non-selective growth inhibition attributable to off-target dopamine/serotonin receptor antagonism or nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a bona fide cytotoxic mechanism.
